title: Gibson Les Paul Premium Electric Guitar Strings, Signature Gauge

long_description.body:
Developed with Les Paul himself, Gibson Les Paul Premium Electric Guitar Strings feature a hex-shaped, tinned steel core precision-wound with pure nickel for durability, clarity, and warmth. Compared to nickel-plated steel, pure nickel strings offer a rounder, fuller vintage-inspired tone with clear response and dynamic output. Les’ suggestion of silk-wrapped ends helps reduce unwanted finger noise, delivering a vintage-style tone with studio-ready clarity.



The hex-shaped, tinned steel core provides durability and volume, while the pure nickel wrap brings the timeless warm voice of vintage Gibson into the present
Uncoated for authentic electric feel and sound
Developed with the late great Les Paul, who specified fine details like the silk-wrapped ends
Made in the USA
Ultra-Light Gauge: .009, .011, .016p, .024, .032, .042
Signature Gauge: .009, .011, .016p, .026, .036, .046
Light Gauge: .010, .013, .017p, .026, .036, .046
